The error message, "AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'extend'", indicates that the method is trying to call `.extend()` on a string instead of a list. This issue arises because `cc` is a positional argument that can accept either a string or a list as input. In the failing test case, `'test@scrapy.org'` is passed directly without any enclosing square brackets, causing it to be treated as a string rather than a list. Consequently, when `rcpts.extend(cc)` is executed on line 57 of the `MailSender` class, Python attempts to call `.extend()` on a string, leading to the AttributeError.
